name: For Skin & Scale
source:
For Skin & Scale is a new fantasy-themed visual novel about two characters doing all they can to escape, in search for a better life. Unfortunately, the baggage of their previous lives is more than ready to weigh them down, in more ways than one.

[From [url=https://koboldcard.itch.io/for-skin-and-scale]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《For Skin & Scale》是一部全新的奇幻题材视觉小说，讲述两名角色竭尽所能逃离现状，寻找更好生活的故事。不幸的是，他们过去人生留下的包袱，正随时准备从各个方面将他们拖垮。

[摘自[url=https://koboldcard.itch.io/for-skin-and-scale]itch.io[/url]]
